# op_environment_variables (Data Source)

Reads the environment variables of a 1Password Environment (beta). Variable values are sensitive.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `environment_id` (String) Environment ID.

### Read-Only

- `variables` (Attributes List) Environment variables. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--variables))

<a id="nestedatt--variables"></a>
### Nested Schema for `variables`

Read-Only:

- `masked` (Boolean) Whether the variable is masked.
- `name` (String) Variable name.
- `value` (String, Sensitive) Variable value.
